purpose: Teach: オシャレ/かまい/壊す/重宝/裕福/ばらばら/図鑑/妖怪

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃の写真、オシャレだったよな、当時の流行りで。
lines.en: You know, Gran, you looked so stylish in those photos from back then — really caught the look of your era.
lines.style: Gentle, nostalgic warmth. Slow measured pace. Soft voice looking back. A light smile underneath — not performing, just remembering.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。年寄りに、付き合ってくれるなら、私、かまいませんよ、孫よ。
lines.en: Yes, well… if you don't mind keeping an old woman company, I'm perfectly happy to, grandchild.
lines.style: Simple, direct kindness. Warm undertone with a touch of self-deprecation. Unhurried breath. The quiet ease of someone comfortable being needed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 子供のおもちゃ、孫が、壊すこと、しょっちゅう、あるよな、最近。
lines.en: Those toys the kids have, you know — they break them pretty often lately. That's how it goes.
lines.style: Observant, gentle musing. Steady pace, not judgmental. A slight shake of the head in the voice — acceptance mixed with quiet amusement at the pattern.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔のお祖母ちゃんのレシピ、本当に、重宝しているわよ、今でも。
lines.en: Those old recipes your grandmother left behind — I really do use them still, even now. They've held up so well.
lines.style: Warm, assured pride. Unhurried delivery. A touch of gratitude threading through — not explaining, just stating a quiet fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 近所の家、最近、結構、裕福になったみたいだな、車が、二台ある。
lines.en: The neighbours seem to have done quite well for themselves lately, haven't they? Two cars in the drive now.
lines.style: Neutral observation with gentle curiosity underneath. Even pace. Not envious — just noticing how things shift. A slight trailing thought.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 家族写真、年々、ばらばらの場所で、撮るようになったわね、孫たち。
lines.en: The family photos, you know — they're taken in different places every year now. The grandchildren scattered all over when we try to gather them.
lines.style: Tender, bittersweet wistfulness. Softer cadence. A slight ache underneath acceptance. The voice of someone watching change happen slowly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の植物図鑑、書斎に、置いてあるよ、ばあさん、知ってる?
lines.en: That old plant guide I have in the study — you remember it, don't you, Gran? Still there on the shelf.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, unhurried. A small invite in the question — checking if memory still holds between them. Warm without pushing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 孫、妖怪の話、本当に、好きみたいね、最近、毎晩、せがむのよ。
lines.en: The grandchildren really do love those yokai stories, don't they? Every single night lately — they won't let me rest until I've told them another one.
lines.style: Affectionate exasperation mixed with genuine warmth. Slightly faster, animated. The indulgent tone of someone who pretends to be worn out but clearly delights in being needed.
